bugs.description: serialize_page changes the published response field from next_cursor to cursor without a versioned contract change.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: Any API request serializes a page for a client that implements the existing version-one response schema.
bugs.observableImpact: Existing clients cannot find next_cursor and therefore stop pagination or reject the response.
bugs.provenance: Seeded wire-key mutation in an otherwise unchanged serializer; test_page_response.py asserts both populated and terminal page shapes.
